title: Apex pH Swing After Dosing
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=apex:reading
| search ph_swing_post_dose=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(ph_swing_post_dose) as avg_ph_swing_post_dose max(ph_swing_post_dose) as max_ph_swing_post_dose by _time tank_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks pH swing after dosing over time and breaks it out by tank.
value: Post-dose pH swing helps show whether the dosing schedule is too abrupt for the system volume.
implementation: Send pH swing after dosing events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of pH swing after dosing by tank.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how pH swing after dosing changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
